run_multiprocess_training: run fairseq distributed training across multiple GPUs on a single node using multiprocessing
create_error_handler: create an ErrorHandler that listens for exceptions in child processes and propagates tracebacks to the parent
spawn_training_processes: spawn multiple torch.multiprocessing Processes, one per GPU, each running the training loop
handle_child_process_errors: handle exceptions from child training processes by collecting tracebacks and killing all children on failure
init_distributed_single_node: initialize distributed training on a single node with auto-detected GPU count and random TCP port
